note: Test-account configuration. Secrets are NEVER stored here: this file only documents the required environment variables. Real values come from the environment (E2E_GATEWAY_TOKEN, E2E_TEST_KEY) and are rotated via e2e/src/key-rotation.ts.

required_environment_variables.E2E_GATEWAY_TOKEN: A short-lived gateway session token for the E2E fake server.
required_environment_variables.E2E_TEST_KEY: A short-lived SSH test key used by E2E journeys.

key_rotation.policy: Active key = <base>-gen<generation>; rotate() advances the generation; keys expire after interval_days.
